title: Practice: негде, некуда, некогда — and нигде, никуда, никогда

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books; word forms checked with the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: ___ раньше не видел, чтобы она так атакующе играла.
exercises.why: **Никогда** — with the negative verb: «Used with any negative (НЕ) form of the verb, both in personal and impersonal constructions» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 105.
exercises.prompt: I've never seen her play so aggressive before.

exercises.q: Печально известную взломщицу так ___ и не поймали.
exercises.why: **никогда** — with the negative verb: «Used with any negative (НЕ) form of the verb, both in personal and impersonal constructions» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 105.
exercises.prompt: The infamous female burglar was never caught.

exercises.q: Этот скотч ___ не годится — постоянно отклеивается.
exercises.why: **никуда** — with the negative verb: «Used with any negative (НЕ) form of the verb, both in personal and impersonal constructions» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 105.
exercises.prompt: This sellotape is no good – it keeps coming off.

exercises.q: Крохи, которые я получаю в качестве жалования, ___ не годятся.
exercises.why: **никуда** — with the negative verb: «Used with any negative (НЕ) form of the verb, both in personal and impersonal constructions» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 105.
exercises.prompt: The chicken feed I get for a salary is good for nothing.

exercises.q: Упомянутых вами имён в списке ___ не значится.
exercises.why: **нигде** — with the negative verb: «Used with any negative (НЕ) form of the verb, both in personal and impersonal constructions» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 105.
exercises.prompt: The names you've mentioned aren't anywhere to be found in the list.

exercises.why: **нигде** — with the negative verb: «Used with any negative (НЕ) form of the verb, both in personal and impersonal constructions» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 105.
exercises.prompt: Tom never stays anywhere very long.

exercises.why: **негде** — followed by an infinitive, no НЕ: «Used with the infinitive of the verb (without НЕ) in impersonal constructions» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 105.
exercises.prompt: There's nowhere to park on Park Drive.

exercises.why: **некогда** — followed by an infinitive, no НЕ: «Used with the infinitive of the verb (without НЕ) in impersonal constructions» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 105.
exercises.prompt: I don't have time to explain.

exercises.why: **некогда** — followed by an infinitive, no НЕ: «Used with the infinitive of the verb (without НЕ) in impersonal constructions» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 105.
exercises.prompt: I have no time to have a rest.

exercises.why: **негде** — followed by an infinitive, no НЕ: «Used with the infinitive of the verb (without НЕ) in impersonal constructions» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 105.
**некуда** — followed by an infinitive, no НЕ: «Used with the infinitive of the verb (without НЕ) in impersonal constructions» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 105.
exercises.prompt: There's nowhere for you to hide.

exercises.why: **некуда** — followed by an infinitive, no НЕ: «Used with the infinitive of the verb (without НЕ) in impersonal constructions» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 105.
exercises.prompt: Tom had no place to go.

exercises.q: Была распутная, теперь никто не берет, так и ___ взять.
exercises.why: **неоткуда** — followed by an infinitive, no НЕ: «Used with the infinitive of the verb (without НЕ) in impersonal constructions» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 105.

exercises.q: Она появилась вдруг там, где она сейчас, ___ не приходя.
exercises.why: **ниоткуда** — with the negative verb: «Used with any negative (НЕ) form of the verb, both in personal and impersonal constructions» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 105.
